journal_lines: Copper. Then iron. Then something that wasn't either. Brought back what could be carried.
The vein changed color three times. Followed it as far as it went.
Mixed seam. Copper into iron into something older. Took all of it.
The seam kept changing and I kept following it.
Three ore types in one run. The pickaxe deserved rest after this.
Mixed vein, long run. Took everything recoverable.
The ore changed character every twenty paces. Followed it all.
Started mining iron, ended up somewhere else entirely. Better.
The mixed seam ran deeper the more it mixed. Followed to the bottom.
Color by color through the rock face. Each one different. All taken.
The kind of vein that makes the whole trip make sense.
Followed the color change three times. Each one rewarded the follow.
